text: 听见打斗声，伯纳德从灌木中冲出来，帮你用皮鞋带绑住那个矮小的男人。
后来在营地里，你仔细检查了他。他脸上的色素异常单一，仿佛血液不是红色。他的手臂比例比常人更长，手指像爪子。他戴着几件小饰物，你希望那是用动物骨头制成的。
你们尝试各种方式与小人沟通，都以失败告终。他十分孤僻，近乎出神。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 281
text: Following the sounds of struggle, Bernard crashes out of the brush. He helps you bind the diminutive man with leather shoelaces.

Later, in camp, you examine the man thoroughly. The pigment in his face seems unnaturally monochromatic, as if his blood did not run red. His arms are proportionally longer than a normal man’s, with claw-like fingers. He wears a few small items of jewelry constructed from what you hope are animal bones.
Every attempt to communicate with the little man fails. He is withdrawn, almost entranced.
